components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Clip-cut cyan action button (View work, Visit site, Send message).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 0.62rem 1.4rem; background: #16d7ff; color: #03152f; border: none; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 10px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 10px)); box-shadow: 0 0 20px -4px rgba(22,215,255,0.55); transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 28px -2px rgba(22,215,255,0.6); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Switch
components.description: Numbered 01-06 section switch; active fills solid cyan.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #9ab4d4; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 9px) 0, 100% 9px, 100% 100%, 9px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 9px)); } .ds-nav:hover { color: #e8f3ff; background: rgba(22,215,255,0.06); } .ds-nav-num { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #6a85a8; } .ds-nav-label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.08rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-active { background: #16d7ff; border-color: #16d7ff; color: #03152f; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-num { color: rgba(3,21,47,0.7); }

components.name: Arcana Card
components.description: Clip-cut project card with a cyan top rule; opens a detail modal on click.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 1rem; background: #061d3d; border: 1px solid rgba(22,215,255,0.18); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 14px) 0, 100% 14px, 100% 100%, 14px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 14px)); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .22s, border-color .22s; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: #16d7ff; box-shadow: 0 0 14px #16d7ff; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #16d7ff; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -18px #16d7ff; } .ds-card-num { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #16d7ff; } .ds-card-thumb { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: #020e20; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.35rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e8f3ff; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Navy-sink field with a mono uppercase label; cyan focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6a85a8; } .ds-field input { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; background: #020e20; border: 1px solid rgba(22,215,255,0.18); color: #e8f3ff; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #16d7ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(22,215,255,0.15); }

narrative.overview: brownbuilds is a numbered control console on a deep-navy screen: a fixed left sidebar of 01-06 section switches, a central stage that wipes between panels, a live clock and a scrolling status ticker. It reads like an arcade-cabinet operator panel - bold condensed caps, monospace readouts, sharp clip-cut corners, and a single electric-cyan signal that lights whatever is active. One accent, not a rainbow; the client screenshots are the only other colour.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy ground (#03152f) with one electric-cyan accent (#16d7ff) - no second accent.
Sidebar app-shell: numbered 01-06 switches, central stage, ticker + clock.
Barlow Condensed display caps + JetBrains Mono for all body and meta.
Sharp corners with a 14px clip-cut on cards, buttons, nav items and panels.
Panels enter with a cyan wipe; motion is scripted, not scattered.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only colour on the interface; it always means 'live / active / here'. Reserved neon hues (pink, violet, lime, amber) exist as tokens but are intentionally unused - do not reintroduce a per-card rainbow.

rules.name: The Work-Is-The-Colour Rule
rules.body: The only non-cyan colour on screen is the real client screenshots inside the arcana grid. Keep it that way.

rules.name: The Mono-Readout Rule
rules.body: Anything that reads like data - section counter, clock, status, field labels, hints - is monospace with wide tracking. Only display and titles switch to condensed caps.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-A-State Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a cyan glow only appears on hover, focus or an open dialog - never ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep cyan as the only interface colour; let the client screenshots be the rest.
Do use the 14px clip-cut consistently on cards, buttons, nav items and panels.
Do set headlines and titles in Barlow Condensed uppercase; everything else in JetBrains Mono.
Do reserve glow for hover / focus / open states.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion - wipes, blink, pulse and ticker all stop.
donts: Don't reintroduce the per-card rainbow (pink / violet / lime / amber accents).
Don't add border-radius; corners are sharp or clip-cut.
Don't let a second colour compete with cyan for 'active/live'.
Don't make the SFX layer play by default - it stays opt-in.
